data.title: InstaVolt joins UK Shell Card charging network
data.description: The UK fast charging network InstaVolt has been added to Shell Card giving fleet operators and drivers access to over 4,250 InstaVolt chargers in more than 1200 locations.

data.title: Li Auto replaces CATL cells with its own battery cells
data.description: Li Auto is reducing its dependence on CATL and will increasingly rely on in-house developed battery cells in the future. The Li 6, intended for Europe, will also receive the new technology.

data.title: BAM identifies lithium isotopes as diagnostic tool for battery ageing
data.description: Researchers at the Federal Institute for Materials Research and Testing have discovered that the distribution of two lithium isotopes in the cells is directly linked to degradation processes, like a fingerprint. This insight is intended to help better understand the ageing mechanisms of batteries.

data.title: Tesla Semi for Europe offers decent range and excellent payload
data.description: Tesla has released the performance data for its electric truck, the Semi, in Europe ahead of IAA Transportation. The figures broadly correspond to the US version with the smaller battery. Customers can expect up to 800 kW of power, around 550 kilometres of range and a relatively high payload.

data.title: Zurich Airport tests autonomous electric shuttles
data.description: Two fully automated electric shuttles without drivers or security personnel are operating on the grounds of Zurich Airport. The minibuses are monitored from a control center. This makes Zurich one of the first airports in Europe to test automated driving at this level.

data.title: Pennsylvania to invest $11 million in EV chargers
data.description: The US state of Pennsylvania is set to invest $11 million USD in new EV charging infrastructure across the Central PA region. This will be the third region where funding has been offered, following the Southeast and West regions earlier this year.

data.title: Wisconsin to add 42 new fast-charging stations
data.description: The US state of Wisconsin is set to gain 42 new fast-charging sites after securing $25 million in federal grant funding through the NEVI programme. This follows a legal dispute involving Wisconsin and 15 other states over the release of federal EV infrastructure funding.

data.title: DPD UK orders 341 Mercedes-Benz eSprinter vans
data.description: Package delivery service DPD is expanding its British delivery fleet with 341 Mercedes eSprinters. The first electric transporters will enter service in September, and all are expected to be operational by the end of October, just in time for the Christmas season. According to DPD, this will grow its British e-fleet to more than 4,000 vehicles.

data.title: First Bus expands smart charging system at Glasgow depot
data.description: UK transport company First Bus is expanding use of a smart charging system at its Caledonia depot in Glasgow, allowing the operator to better manage the energy demand of its electric bus fleet while supporting the power grid.

data.title: BMW iX5 Hydrogen: testing of the upcoming hydrogen SUV underway
data.description: BMW will launch the new generation of the X5 with five powertrain options, including a hydrogen fuel cell. The company has now provided its first insights into the testing of prototypes of the hydrogen SUV, which is set to hit the market in 2028 under the name BMW iX5 Hydrogen.

data.title: VW and Škoda explore joint enture with JSW in India
data.description: The Volkswagen Group is exploring a joint venture with the JSW conglomerate for its brands Skoda and VW active in India. This could also benefit the EV platform the brand have planned for India - where they currently only offer combustion engine vehicles.

data.title: Volvo EX40 facelift now available from €47,490
data.description: Volvo is giving the EX40 a facelift and slightly adjusting its technology in the process. The nomenclature is also changing, analogous to the smaller EX30. Production of the revised electric compact is scheduled to start in November, with first deliveries of the facelift model expected by the end of 2026.

data.title: R3 Lithium launches lithium recycling facility in Georgia
data.description: R3 Lithium has started producing lithium carbonate from recycled battery materials in the US state of Georgia. The existing plant is designed for 2,500 tons per year and is now being transitioned to continuous commercial operation.

data.title: China’s EV boom increasingly driven by exports
data.description: In August, EVs and plug-in hybrids manufactured in China achieved a sales volume of 1.64 million units, an 18 per cent increase year-on-year. However, the drivetrain types are developing very differently: plug-in hybrids are stagnating, while pure electric cars are at an annual high - with exports becoming a key pillar.

data.title: How Audi shortened development time for the A2 e-tron
data.description: Audi has revealed key details about the development and production of the A2 e-tron at its Ingolstadt plant. According to the Volkswagen subsidiary, the development timeline for the electric A2 was reduced by nearly two years compared to previous vehicle projects.

data.title: $20,300 in EV purchase incentives for California rideshare drivers
data.description: California's Public Utilities Commission (CPUC) has approved a new incentive programme offering rideshare drivers up to $20,300 towards the purchase or lease of a new zero-emission vehicle. The Drivers Assistance Program is aimed at low- and middle-income drivers working for companies like Uber, Lyft, and HopSkipDrive.

data.title: EU Commission proposes new procurement rules: more Europe, less China
data.description: The EU Commission wants to reform public procurement law to make it easier to exclude non-EU companies from tenders. The EU Commission has Chinese firms in mind, with EU Commissioner Stéphane Séjourné citing BYD's electric buses as an example. However, these are mostly built in Hungary.

data.title: Vietnam: VinFast to supply 3,000 electric cars for Green SM
data.description: Vietnamese automaker VinFast has secured an order for 3,000 EVs to homegrown transport operator Xe Nhanh Viet Nam. The latter will deploy these EVs on the Green SM platform by 2027.

data.title: Volkswagen ID.3 Neo test reveals an electric car that does what it’s meant to
data.description: The controls in the Volkswagen ID.3 Neo are now haptic push buttons and rotary knobs. No one misses the sliders. But what really sets this VW apart is not the new interior – although it does have a great spacious feel – it's actually the overall package that is most pleasantly convincing. The ID.3 has now become a genuinely good electric car.

data.title: Wallbox Chargers closes US plant – in favour of Spain
data.description: Spanish charging station manufacturer Wallbox Chargers is shutting down its production in the USA and relocating it to Barcelona. The measure only affects production and, according to the company, does not represent a withdrawal from the US market. The company now plans to supply North American customers from Barcelona.
